commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.

90+5' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Marc Bernal (Barcelona). Alejandro Ruiz saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. Elche win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
90+3' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
90+2' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

90+1' Adam Boayar (Elche) creates himself some space inside the goalmouth and connects with the free kick. His accurate header would have probably ended up inside the right post, but Joan Garcia pulls off a superb reflex save to thwart him.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Alejandro Ruiz shows a yellow card to Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona) for a tough tackle.
87' The corner from Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) is hurriedly cleared.
87' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball. It will be a corner kick for Barcelona.
85' Substitution. Marc Casado (Barcelona) replaces Fermín.
84' Hansi Flick is forced to make a change. Jules Kounde (Barcelona) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Ronald Araujo.

83' He should have scored! Lucas Cepeda (Elche) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot low towards the middle of the goal is pretty weak and Joan Garcia makes an easy save.
82' Robert Lewandowski picks out Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) unmarked inside the box, but his strike goes well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Elche.
82' Elche have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
79' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
76' Alejandro Ruiz shows the yellow card to Rodrigo Mendoza (Elche) for a heavy challenge.
74' Eder Sarabia decides to make a substitution. Alvaro Rodriguez will be replaced by Lucas Cepeda (Elche).
74' Substitution. David Affengruber walks off the pitch and Leo Petrot (Elche) comes on as a substitute.
74' Eder Sarabia appears to have said too much and referee Alejandro Ruiz comes over and theatrically shows him a yellow card.
73' The attendance is 31233.
72' 1 - 3 Goal! Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) fires the rebound into the roof of the net after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:3.
68' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the right post.
68' Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle and signals a foul after David Affengruber (Elche) brought his opponent down. Barcelona have a free kick.
66' Barcelona failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
65' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
65' Great save! Fermín (Barcelona) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom right corner was brilliantly saved by Inaki Pena.

63' The rebound finds Adam Boayar (Elche) in space inside the box, but his shot goes well wide of the right post. That was a promising chance! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Barcelona.
62' The game has come to an end for Ferran Torres. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona).
62' Hansi Flick has decided to substitute Dani Olmo and he is replaced by Marc Bernal (Barcelona).

61' The game is interrupted. Jules Kounde (Barcelona) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. Elche win a free kick.
60' The substitution is prepared. Adam Boayar (Elche) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Andre Silva.
60' Eder Sarabia has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Martim Neto (Elche) replacing Grady Diangana.
59' Alejandro Ruiz interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Rodrigo Mendoza (Elche). A free kick is awarded to Barcelona.
57' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
56' The substitution has been made. Federico Redondo Solari (Elche) has replaced Marc Aguado.
55' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.
51' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Rodrigo Mendoza (Elche) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.

50' Alvaro Rodriguez (Elche) has a chance after receiving a pass. He measures his shot from the edge of the box but it sails just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Barcelona will have a goal kick.
48' Adria Pedrosa (Elche) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
46' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) will take the corner.
46' Half-time substitution. Hansi Flick decided to make a change. Raphinha is replaced by Marcus Rashford (Barcelona).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+4' Raphinha (Barcelona) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
45+4' Barcelona take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
45+2' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) picks up a pass inside the box and finds some space for a shot before unleashing a low drive goalwards, but one of the defending players blocks his effort.
45+1' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Raphinha, but he can't get on the end of the pass. The ball has crossed the sideline. Elche are taking a throw-in.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.

45' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Fermín (Barcelona), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches over the top. The ball goes out of play and Elche will have a goal kick.
44' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) commits a rough foul. Alejandro Ruiz stops the game and makes a call. Elche get a free kick.

43' What a chance that is! Raphinha (Barcelona) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Elche will have a goal kick.
42' Fermín (Barcelona) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Elche will have a goal kick.

40' 1 - 2 Goal! Frenkie de Jong plays in Ferran Torres (Barcelona), who shows great determination to get to the ball before a couple of defenders and from inside the box he shoots into the top of the net! Great finish - 1:2.

39' Inaki Pena is a nightmare for the offensive players! Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) meets a cross on the edge of the penalty area, takes a good first touch and fires a rocket of a shot towards the right post, but the goalkeeper produces a wonderful save.
38' John Donald (Elche) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Alejandro Ruiz didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
36' Raphinha (Barcelona) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
32' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) expertly controls a neat clever pass inside the box, but his effort crashes against the crossbar! What an opportunity that was!
31' The linesman raises his flag. Ferran Torres (Barcelona) is adjudged offside.
29' 1 - 1 Alvaro Rodriguez (Elche) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and drills a shot into the bottom right corner in trademark fashion.

28' What a chance that is! Dani Olmo (Barcelona) wastes a huge opportunity as he receives a beautiful pass on the edge of the box and fires towards the net. Unfortunately for him, he only hits the crossbar! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Elche.
28' Raphinha (Barcelona) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
27' Raphinha (Barcelona) sends a cross into the box, but Inaki Pena comes off his line to gather the ball.
26' Dani Olmo receives a sweet cross inside the box from Lamine Yamal (Barcelona), but one of the defenders rushes in bravely to intercept the ball.
25' Rodrigo Mendoza (Elche) misses the left post by a whisker with a mid-range rebound. What a chance that was! The ball goes out of play and Barcelona will have a goal kick.
22' Rodrigo Mendoza (Elche) threads a pass through to Alvaro Rodriguez, but Joan Garcia breaks up the move.
20' Lamine Yamal received a clever long ball from Fermín (Barcelona) which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert and managed to avert the threat.

18' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Elche.

16' Chance! Dani Olmo (Barcelona) comes within inches of scoring after picking up a pass from Alejandro Balde, but his shot from inside the box flashes inches wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Elche.
15' The Barcelona players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
12' Alvaro Rodriguez (Elche) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
9' Grady Diangana (Elche) takes the corner kick, but Joan Garcia reads it well and stops the effort.

7' German Valera (Elche) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Barcelona.
6' 0 - 1 Fantastic team goal! Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) was set free in the area by Dani Olmo and fired low past Inaki Pena. 0:1.
5' Raphinha (Barcelona) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
5' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) sends a promising through ball, but the defence is alert and cuts out the pass.
4' Raphinha (Barcelona) finds some space for a shot after collecting the ball and unleashes a rocket of a shot from long distance towards the net. The goalkeeper thwarts the effort.

2' Fermín plays a lovely pass into Lamine Yamal (Barcelona), but he can't find the target. His strike from inside the box goes narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Elche will have a goal kick.
1' The first half has just begun.
Barcelona will kick the game off.
